narrative:
## Handover Summary — Income Baseline

The income baseline is locked at the group level and cascaded to business line, product and region.

## Key Decisions
• Wealth Management baseline lifted on net-flow evidence; fee-yield compression kept in Phase 3
• Life Insurance uplift capped so the solvency ratio stays above 170%
• Mortgage income held flat — rate sensitivity handed to Treasury in Phase 2

## Recommendation for NII & Margin
Treasury should stress the Euribor path and deposit betas against this baseline. A 25bp lower path removes ~EUR 4M NII (≈1.2pp of C/I).

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.

signals.title: Aktia Fund Flows — Q3 Net Subscriptions
signals.excerpt: Net subscriptions of EUR 420M YTD, led by fixed income and the Nordic Micro Cap fund. Monthly fund savings agreements up 11% via the mobile app.
